scenarios: the install request goes to the installer with the phone’s key; installed or updated rebuilds the adapter, nothing else does
a request that changes nothing keeps the live adapter: installed and current for that key before it
a request that ends after an adapter built before the install rebuilds it
one prompt per request and none after a refusal: a decline latches for every session until restart
one session holds the helper: only its runs, grants, input and helper events; the hold passes on deactivation or when it ends
the four challenges the helper still keeps (issued at 0, 2, 4 and 6 s) stay answerable; the fifth evicts the oldest
a handover at the same epoch still revokes: the successor’s input waits for its own grant for a new challenge
an old challenge of the previous holder is dead after the handover
a check that reads installed while the adapter reports not installed rebuilds it
a check never rebuilds an installed adapter
ensureRunning starts a stopped service through the installer; callers together share one attempt; a connected helper needs none
dispose: the adapter goes, and a request that ends later rebuilds nothing
a lease reads the current adapter’s connection, desktop, session and lock state, also after a rebuild
a grant the helper refuses opens no input; the next challenge’s grant does
a lease taken after the helper was disposed is inert
